<style>
.wrbk {
  
  --bg: #161412; --surface: #1f1c19; --surface-2: #2a2622; --ink: #f0ece4; --ink-2: #c4bdb1; --ink-3: #8f887d;
  --line: #3a352f; --accent: #d98b56; --accent-ink: #1a1410; --accent-soft: #3a2a1f; --warn: #e0a440; --good: #5cc28f;
  color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.55;
}

    --bg: #f7f5f0; --surface: #fffdf9; --surface-2: #efebe2; --ink: #1f1c17; --ink-2: #57514a; --ink-3: #8a8379;
    --line: #ddd6ca; --accent: #8a4b22; --accent-ink: #ffffff; --accent-soft: #f3e6da; --warn: #9a6400; --good: #1f7a4d;
}
.wrbk * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.wrbk .wk-app { max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 0 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.wrbk header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 0 10px; }

  width: 100%; min-height: 54px; border-radius: 12px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink);
}

.wrbk .qadd input, .wrbk .qadd select { font: inherit; font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 10px; width: 100%; }
.wrbk .qadd button { border: none; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border-radius: 9px; padding: 0 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
.wrbk .modes { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin-top: 16px; }
.wrbk .modes button { text-align: left; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.wrbk .modes button b { display: block; font-size: 1.02rem; }
.wrbk .modes button span { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: .9rem; }

.wrbk .fld label { display: block; font-size: .82rem; color: var(--ink-2); margin-bottom: 3px; }
.wrbk .fld select, .wrbk .fld input { width: 100%; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 10px; }
.wrbk .sec { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--ink-3); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; font-weight: 600; margin: 22px 0 6px; }

.wrbk .hcard .hd { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 700; }
.wrbk .hcard .hd button { background: none; border: none; color: var(--ink-3); font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; cursor: pointer; }

    <b>Beta.</b> A learning and screening aid that does not replace classification by a qualified soil scientist. Simplified field key to the Reference Soil Groups of the World Reference Base for Soil Resources, 4th edition (IUSS Working Group WRB, 2022). It does not replace the full key, diagnostic definitions or qualifier lists in the WRB text. <a href="https://wrb.isric.org/documents.html">WRB documents</a>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// Simplified WRB 2022 key engine for the RafikiArdhi WRB key.
// Every threshold lives in WRB_T so it can be checked against WRB 2022 Chapters 3 and 4.
(function (root) {
  const WRB_T = {
    histicOrganicCm: 40,          // Histosols: organic material within 100 cm
    leptoRockCm: 25,              // Leptosols: continuous rock starting within
    leptoCoarsePct: 80,           // Leptosols: coarse fragments averaged over 0-75 cm (i.e. < 20% fine earth)
    natricESP: 15,                // Solonetz: exchangeable sodium percentage, in a horizon with an argic-type clay increase
    vertisolClayPct: 30,          // Vertisols: clay from surface down to the vertic horizon
    salicEC: 15,                  // Solonchaks: EC of saturation extract (dS/m)
    salicDepthCm: 50,
    planoDepthCm: 75,             // Planosols: abrupt textural difference within
    nitisolClayPct: 30,
    ferralicCECclay: 16,          // cmol(+)/kg clay
    ferralicDepthCm: 150, ferralicThickCm: 30,
    darkValue: 3, darkChroma: 3, darkOC: 0.6, darkThickCm: 20,
    chernicChroma: 2, chernicOC: 1,
    baseSat: 50,
    carbonatePresentPct: 1,       // secondary carbonates detected (CaCO3 equivalent)
    chernoCarbBelowCm: 50, kastanoCarbBelowCm: 70,
    gypsicPct: 5, calcicPct: 15, accumThickCm: 15, accumDepthCm: 100,
    argicDepthCm: 100,
    // clay increase to the horizon below: upper < 10% -> +4 points; 10-50% -> ratio 1.4; >= 50% -> +20 points
    argicLowClay: 10, argicLowAdd: 4, argicRatio: 1.4, argicHighClay: 50, argicHighAdd: 20,
    lowActivityCECclay: 24,
    arenoCoarsePct: 40
  };

  const yn = v => v === "y" ? true : v === "n" ? false : null;
  const has = v => v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== "" && isFinite(v);

  // weighted mean of field f over [z1,z2] using horizons that have it; null if none
  function wmean(hz, f, z1, z2) {
    let s = 0, w = 0;
    hz.forEach(h => { const o = Math.max(0, Math.min(h.bottom, z2) - Math.max(h.top, z1)); if (o > 0 && has(h[f])) { s += h[f] * o; w += o; } });
    return w > 0 ? { v: s / w, cover: w / (z2 - z1) } : null;
  }

  function classify(site, horizons, T = WRB_T) {
    const hz = horizons.filter(h => has(h.top) && has(h.bottom) && h.bottom > h.top).sort((a, b) => a.top - b.top);
    const depth = hz.length ? hz[hz.length - 1].bottom : 0;
    const out = [];
    const add = (code, ok, note) => out.push({ code, ok, note });

    // HS
    add("HS", has(site.organicCm) ? site.organicCm >= T.histicOrganicCm : null, has(site.organicCm) ? `${site.organicCm} cm organic material` : "organic layer thickness not given");
    add("AT", yn(site.anthric), "field observation");
    add("TC", yn(site.artefacts), "field observation");
    add("CR", yn(site.permafrost), "field observation");
    // LP: rock within 25 cm, or < 20% fine earth (coarse fragments >= 80%) over 0-75 cm
    {
      let ok = site.rock === "none" ? false : has(site.rock) ? site.rock <= T.leptoRockCm : null;
      const note = [];
      if (has(site.rock)) note.push(`rock at ${site.rock} cm`); else if (site.rock === "none") note.push("no rock within 100 cm");
      const cf = wmean(hz, "cf", 0, 75);
      if (cf) { note.push(`coarse fragments ${cf.v.toFixed(0)}% (0–75 cm)`); if (cf.v >= T.leptoCoarsePct) ok = true; }
      add("LP", ok, note.join("; ") || "rock depth and coarse fragments not given");
    }
    // SN: horizon starting within 100 cm with ESP >= threshold and more clay than the one above
    {
      const cand = hz.filter((h, i) => h.top < 100 && has(h.esp));
      let ok = cand.length ? false : yn(site.sodic), note = cand.length ? "" : "field observation (no ESP data)";
      cand.forEach(h => { const i = hz.indexOf(h), up = hz[i - 1]; const clayUp = !!up && has(h.clay) && has(up.clay) && (up.clay < T.argicLowClay ? h.clay - up.clay >= T.argicLowAdd : up.clay < T.argicHighClay ? h.clay / up.clay >= T.argicRatio : h.clay - up.clay >= T.argicHighAdd);
        if (h.esp >= T.natricESP && clayUp) { ok = true; note = `ESP ${h.esp}% at ${h.top} cm`; } });
      if (ok === false && cand.length) note = `max ESP ${Math.max(...cand.map(h => h.esp))}%`;
      add("SN", ok, note);
    }
    // VR
    {
      const s = yn(site.slickensides); let ok = s, note = "slickensides / wedge-shaped aggregates";
      if (s === true) {
        const top = hz.filter(h => h.top < 100);
        if (!top.length || top.some(h => !has(h.clay))) ok = null, note = "slickensides present but clay not given";
        else { ok = top.every(h => h.clay >= T.vertisolClayPct); note = `clay ${Math.min(...top.map(h => h.clay))}–${Math.max(...top.map(h => h.clay))}% above 100 cm`; }
      }
      add("VR", ok, note);
    }
    // SC
    {
      const c = hz.filter(h => h.top < T.salicDepthCm && has(h.ec));
      add("SC", c.length ? c.some(h => h.ec >= T.salicEC) : yn(site.saline), c.length ? `max EC ${Math.max(...c.map(h => h.ec))} dS/m within ${T.salicDepthCm} cm` : "field observation (no EC data)");
    }
    add("GL", yn(site.gleyic), "field observation");
    add("AN", yn(site.andic), "field observation");
    add("PZ", yn(site.spodic), "field observation");
    add("PT", yn(site.plinthic), "field observation");
    // PL: stagnic + abrupt textural difference within 75 cm
    {
      const st = yn(site.stagnic); let ok = st, note = "stagnic properties";
      if (st === true) {
        let abrupt = null;
        for (let i = 1; i < hz.length; i++) {
          const a = hz[i - 1], b = hz[i]; if (b.top > T.planoDepthCm) break;
          if (!has(a.clay) || !has(b.clay)) continue;
          const at = a.clay >= 20 ? b.clay - a.clay >= 20 : b.clay >= 2 * a.clay;
          abrupt = abrupt || at; if (at) note = `clay ${a.clay}→${b.clay}% at ${b.top} cm`;
        }
        ok = abrupt; if (abrupt === false) note = "no abrupt clay increase within 75 cm"; if (abrupt === null) note = "stagnic, but clay not given";
      }
      add("PL", ok, note);
    }
    add("ST", yn(site.stagnic), "field observation");
    // NT
    {
      const n = yn(site.nitic); let ok = n, note = "nitic structure and shiny ped faces";
      if (n === true) { const c = hz.filter(h => h.top < 100 && has(h.clay)); ok = c.length ? c.some(h => h.clay >= T.nitisolClayPct) : null; note = c.length ? `max clay ${Math.max(...c.map(h => h.clay))}%` : "clay not given"; }
      add("NT", ok, note);
    }
    // FR
    {
      const c = hz.filter(h => h.top < T.ferralicDepthCm && has(h.cec) && has(h.clay) && h.clay > 0);
      let ok = c.length ? false : yn(site.ferralic), note = c.length ? "" : "field judgement (no CEC data)";
      if (c.length) {
        const v = c.map(h => ({ h, r: h.cec / (h.clay / 100) }));
        const low = v.filter(x => x.r < T.ferralicCECclay), thick = low.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.h.bottom - x.h.top), 0);
        ok = thick >= T.ferralicThickCm;
        note = `lowest CEC ${Math.min(...v.map(x => x.r)).toFixed(1)} cmol/kg clay`;
      }
      add("FR", ok, note);
    }
    // Dark topsoil group
    {
      let dark = null, darkBottom = 0, dk = [];
      if (hz.length && hz[0].top === 0) {
        for (const h of hz) {
          if (!has(h.value) || !has(h.chroma) || !has(h.oc)) { if (!dk.length) dark = null; break; }
          if (h.value <= T.darkValue && h.chroma <= T.darkChroma && h.oc >= T.darkOC && h.top === (dk.length ? dk[dk.length - 1].bottom : 0)) dk.push(h); else break;
        }
        const thick = dk.reduce((s, h) => s + h.bottom - h.top, 0);
        if (dk.length || has(hz[0].value)) dark = thick >= T.darkThickCm;
        darkBottom = dk.length ? dk[dk.length - 1].bottom : 0;
      }
      const bsDark = dk.length && dk.every(h => has(h.bs)) ? Math.min(...dk.map(h => h.bs)) : null;
      const mollic = dark && bsDark !== null ? bsDark >= T.baseSat : null;
      const carbTop = hz.find(h => has(h.caco3) && h.caco3 >= T.carbonatePresentPct && h.top >= darkBottom);
      const carbKnown = hz.some(h => has(h.caco3));
      const chernic = dark && dk.every(h => h.chroma <= T.chernicChroma && h.oc >= T.chernicOC);
      const notDark = `dark topsoil ${dark === null ? "not assessed (colour or organic carbon missing)" : `${darkBottom} cm thick`}`;
      const g = (ok, note) => dark === false ? false : (dark === null ? null : ok);
      add("CH", g(mollic === null ? null : mollic && chernic && (carbKnown ? !!carbTop && carbTop.top <= darkBottom + T.chernoCarbBelowCm : null)), dark ? `chernic ${chernic ? "yes" : "no"}; carbonates ${carbTop ? "from " + carbTop.top + " cm" : carbKnown ? "none" : "not given"}` : notDark);
      add("KS", g(mollic === null ? null : mollic && (carbKnown ? !!carbTop && carbTop.top <= darkBottom + T.kastanoCarbBelowCm : null)), dark ? `mollic ${mollic === null ? "?" : mollic ? "yes" : "no"} (BS ${bsDark ?? "?"}%)` : notDark);
      const bs100 = hz.filter(h => h.top < 100); const bsAll = bs100.every(h => has(h.bs)) ? bs100.every(h => h.bs >= T.baseSat) : null;
      add("PH", g(mollic === null ? null : mollic && (bsAll === null ? null : bsAll)), dark ? `base saturation ${bsAll === null ? "not given for all horizons" : bsAll ? "≥ 50% to 100 cm" : "< 50% somewhere above 100 cm"}` : notDark);
      add("UM", g(true), dark ? "dark topsoil with low base saturation" : notDark);
    }
    add("DU", yn(site.duric), "field observation");
    const accum = (f, thr) => { const c = hz.filter(h => h.top < T.accumDepthCm && has(h[f])); return c.length ? c.some(h => h[f] >= thr && h.bottom - h.top >= T.accumThickCm) : null; };
    const gy = accum("gypsum", T.gypsicPct), cl = accum("caco3", T.calcicPct);
    add("GY", gy !== null ? gy : yn(site.gypsic), gy !== null ? "gypsum % within 100 cm" : "field observation (no gypsum data)");
    add("CL", cl !== null ? cl : yn(site.calcic), cl !== null ? "CaCO₃ equivalent % within 100 cm" : "field observation (no CaCO₃ data)");
    // Argic group
    {
      let argic = null, aH = null, note = "clay not given for consecutive horizons";
      for (let i = 1; i < hz.length; i++) {
        const a = hz[i - 1], b = hz[i]; if (b.top > T.argicDepthCm) break;
        if (!has(a.clay) || !has(b.clay)) continue;
        const ok = a.clay < T.argicLowClay ? b.clay - a.clay >= T.argicLowAdd : a.clay < T.argicHighClay ? b.clay / a.clay >= T.argicRatio : b.clay - a.clay >= T.argicHighAdd;
        if (argic === null) argic = false;
        if (ok) { argic = true; aH = b; note = `clay ${a.clay}→${b.clay}% at ${b.top} cm`; break; }
        note = "no qualifying clay increase within 100 cm";
      }
      const R = (ok, n) => argic === false ? false : argic === null ? null : ok;
      add("RT", R(yn(site.retic)), argic ? `${note}; retic properties ${site.retic === "y" ? "yes" : site.retic === "n" ? "no" : "?"}` : note);
      const act = aH && has(aH.cec) && aH.clay > 0 ? aH.cec / (aH.clay / 100) : null;
      const lowAct = act === null ? null : act < T.lowActivityCECclay;
      const lowBS = aH && has(aH.bs) ? aH.bs < T.baseSat : null;
      const detail = argic ? `${note}; CEC ${act === null ? "?" : act.toFixed(1)} cmol/kg clay; BS ${aH && has(aH.bs) ? aH.bs : "?"}%` : note;
      const both = (x, y) => x === null || y === null ? null : x && y;
      add("AC", R(both(lowAct, lowBS)), detail);
      add("LX", R(both(lowAct, lowBS === null ? null : !lowBS)), detail);
      add("AL", R(both(lowAct === null ? null : !lowAct, lowBS)), detail);
      add("LV", R(both(lowAct === null ? null : !lowAct, lowBS === null ? null : !lowBS)), detail);
    }
    add("CM", yn(site.cambic), "field observation");
    add("FL", yn(site.fluvic), "field observation");
    // AR: loamy sand or coarser (silt + 2 clay < 30) and < 40% coarse fragments, 0-100 cm
    {
      const zb = Math.min(100, depth || 100);
      const fine = hz.map(h => ({ ...h, fx: has(h.clay) && has(h.sand) ? (100 - h.sand - h.clay) + 2 * h.clay : null }));
      const fx = wmean(fine, "fx", 0, zb), cf = wmean(hz, "cf", 0, zb);
      add("AR", fx ? fx.v < 30 && (!cf || cf.v < T.arenoCoarsePct) : null, fx ? `silt + 2×clay ${fx.v.toFixed(0)} (sandy if < 30)` : "sand and clay not given");
    }
    // Resolve in key order
    const unsure = [];
    for (const r of out) {
      if (r.ok === true) return { code: r.code, trail: out.slice(0, out.indexOf(r) + 1), unsure };
      if (r.ok === null) unsure.push(r);
    }
    return { code: "RG", trail: out, unsure };
  }
  root.WRBEngine = { classify, WRB_T };
  if (typeof module !== 'undefined') module.exports = root.WRBEngine;
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);

</script>
<script>
(function () {
"use strict";
/* Each node: a question in WRB key order. yes -> result code or next node id; no -> next node id.
   Groups that need the same diagnostic (mollic group, argic group) are asked as a short sub-sequence,
   keeping the published key order. Thresholds are simplified; see the WRB 2022 Chapters 3 and 4. */
const RSG = {
  HS: ["Histosols", "Soils with thick organic layers, such as peats and mucks."],
  AT: ["Anthrosols", "Soils profoundly changed by long, intensive human use such as irrigation, adding materials or wet cultivation."],
  TC: ["Technosols", "Soils with many artefacts or technical hard material, such as urban, mine and industrial soils."],
  CR: ["Cryosols", "Soils with permafrost close to the surface."],
  LP: ["Leptosols", "Thin soils over hard rock, or soils dominated by coarse fragments."],
  SN: ["Solonetz", "Soils with a dense subsoil rich in exchangeable sodium."],
  VR: ["Vertisols", "Heavy clay soils that shrink and crack when dry and swell when wet."],
  SC: ["Solonchaks", "Soils with high concentrations of soluble salts."],
  GL: ["Gleysols", "Soils saturated by groundwater, or under water or in tidal areas, long enough to develop reducing conditions."],
  AN: ["Andosols", "Light, porous soils from volcanic material, rich in allophane or aluminium–humus complexes."],
  PZ: ["Podzols", "Soils with a subsoil accumulation of humus and/or iron and aluminium oxides, often under a bleached layer."],
  PT: ["Plinthosols", "Soils with iron accumulations that harden on exposure (plinthite) or have already hardened."],
  PL: ["Planosols", "Soils with stagnant water perched above an abrupt change to a much finer subsoil."],
  ST: ["Stagnosols", "Soils with stagnant (perched) water and a structural or moderate textural difference."],
  NT: ["Nitisols", "Deep, well-drained red tropical soils with strong nutty structure and shiny ped faces."],
  FR: ["Ferralsols", "Deeply weathered tropical soils dominated by kaolinite and iron and aluminium oxides."],
  CH: ["Chernozems", "Very dark, humus-rich topsoils over secondary carbonates, typical of steppes."],
  KS: ["Kastanozems", "Dark, humus-rich topsoils with secondary carbonates, typical of drier steppes."],
  PH: ["Phaeozems", "Dark, humus-rich topsoils with high base saturation and no shallow carbonates."],
  UM: ["Umbrisols", "Dark, humus-rich but acid topsoils with low base saturation."],
  DU: ["Durisols", "Soils with secondary silica accumulation, often cemented (duripan)."],
  GY: ["Gypsisols", "Soils with secondary gypsum accumulation."],
  CL: ["Calcisols", "Soils with secondary carbonate accumulation."],
  RT: ["Retisols", "Soils where coarser, paler material tongues into a finer, more strongly coloured clay-enriched subsoil."],
  AC: ["Acrisols", "Clay-enriched subsoil with low-activity clays and low base saturation."],
  LX: ["Lixisols", "Clay-enriched subsoil with low-activity clays and high base saturation."],
  AL: ["Alisols", "Clay-enriched subsoil with high-activity clays and low base saturation."],
  LV: ["Luvisols", "Clay-enriched subsoil with high-activity clays and high base saturation."],
  CM: ["Cambisols", "Moderately developed soils with a subsurface horizon showing alteration (colour, structure or weathering)."],
  FL: ["Fluvisols", "Young soils in river, lake or marine deposits, still showing their layering."],
  AR: ["Arenosols", "Deep sandy soils with little development."],
  RG: ["Regosols", "Soils with little or no profile development that do not fit any other group."]
};

const Q = [
  { id: "HS", step: "Organic soils", q: "Is there a thick layer of organic material (peat or muck) near the surface?",
    help: ["Roughly 40 cm or more of organic material within the upper 100 cm, or at least 10 cm of it directly over rock or rubble.",
           "Organic material: very dark, light when dry, made mostly of plant remains; roughly 20% organic carbon or more."] },
  { id: "AT", step: "Human-influenced soils", q: "Has long, intensive human use built or reshaped a thick topsoil?",
    help: ["About 50 cm or more of a human-made horizon: hortic (long manuring and garden use), irragric (irrigation sediment), plaggic (sod or manure additions), pretic (ancient dark earths) or terric (added mineral material).",
           "Or a puddled, wet-rice layer (anthraquic) over an iron/manganese-enriched subsoil (hydragric)."] },
  { id: "TC", step: "Human-influenced soils", q: "Does the soil contain many artefacts, or sit on a sealed or technical surface?",
    help: ["About 20% or more artefacts (bricks, glass, plastics, mine spoil, ash) by volume in the upper 100 cm.",
           "Or a geomembrane or continuous technical hard material (such as asphalt or concrete) starting within about 5 cm."] },
  { id: "CR", step: "Root limitations", q: "Is there permafrost within the upper 100 cm?",
    help: ["A cryic horizon: perennially frozen soil (ice-cemented or visible ice), starting within 100 cm of the surface."] },
  { id: "LP", step: "Root limitations", q: "Is the soil very shallow over hard rock, or made up mostly of stones and gravel?",
    help: ["Continuous hard rock (or technical hard material) starting within 25 cm of the surface.",
           "Or less than about 20% fine earth (by volume) averaged over the upper 75 cm."] },
  { id: "SN", step: "Root limitations", q: "Is there a dense, sodium-rich subsoil within 100 cm?",
    help: ["A natric horizon: clay-enriched subsoil, often with columnar or prismatic structure and rounded tops, starting within 100 cm.",
           "Exchangeable sodium about 15% of CEC or more (or Na + Mg above Ca + exchange acidity) in that horizon."] },
  { id: "VR", step: "Root limitations", q: "Is it a heavy clay that cracks when dry, with polished, grooved ped faces?",
    help: ["A vertic horizon (slickensides and/or wedge-shaped aggregates) starting within 100 cm.",
           "About 30% clay or more from the surface down to the vertic horizon; wide cracks open and close with the seasons."] },
  { id: "SC", step: "Root limitations", q: "Is the soil strongly salty near the surface?",
    help: ["A salic horizon starting within 50 cm: high soluble salt content (electrical conductivity of the saturation extract roughly 15 dS/m or more, lower in alkaline soils).",
           "Field signs: salt crusts or efflorescences, salt-tolerant vegetation."] },
  { id: "GL", step: "Iron and aluminium chemistry", q: "Is the soil saturated by groundwater near the surface, or permanently under water or tidal?",
    help: ["Gleyic properties (grey, green or blue reduced colours, rusty mottles along roots or pores) in a layer at least 25 cm thick starting within about 40 cm, with reducing conditions.",
           "Or the soil is under water or in a tidal zone."] },
  { id: "AN", step: "Iron and aluminium chemistry", q: "Is it a light, fluffy, volcanic soil (andic or vitric properties)?",
    help: ["Andic or vitric properties in layers totalling about 30 cm within 100 cm, starting within 25 cm.",
           "Andic lab cues: Al(ox) + ½Fe(ox) ≥ 2%, bulk density ≤ 0.9 g/cm³, phosphate retention ≥ 85%. Field cue: smeary, greasy feel, positive NaF test."] },
  { id: "PZ", step: "Iron and aluminium chemistry", q: "Is there a subsoil accumulation of dark humus and/or reddish iron and aluminium (spodic horizon)?",
    help: ["A spodic horizon starting within 200 cm, often under a bleached, ash-grey (albic) layer.",
           "Typical of acid, sandy soils under heath or coniferous forest."] },
  { id: "PT", step: "Iron and aluminium chemistry", q: "Are there iron-rich mottles that harden irreversibly, or an ironstone layer or concretions, near the surface?",
    help: ["A plinthic, petroplinthic or pisoplinthic horizon starting within 50 cm (or within 100 cm under a bleached or stagnic layer).",
           "Plinthite: red, iron-rich mottles in a lighter matrix that harden on repeated wetting and drying."] },
  { id: "PL", step: "Iron and aluminium chemistry", q: "Is there an abrupt change to a much finer subsoil, with signs of perched water above it?",
    help: ["An abrupt textural difference (clay roughly doubling over a short distance) within 75 cm.",
           "Stagnic properties (pale, bleached ped surfaces with rusty interiors) and reducing conditions in the layer directly above it."] },
  { id: "ST", step: "Iron and aluminium chemistry", q: "Does water perch in the upper soil, leaving bleached and rusty mottled patterns?",
    help: ["Stagnic properties with reducing conditions in a substantial part of the soil starting within about 60 cm.",
           "Typical pattern: pale, bleached zones along cracks and ped faces with rusty or dark concentrations inside peds."] },
  { id: "NT", step: "Iron and aluminium chemistry", q: "Is there a deep, clayey, red subsoil with strong nutty blocks and shiny ped faces (nitic horizon)?",
    help: ["A nitic horizon starting within 100 cm: at least 30% clay, moderate to strong angular blocky or nutty structure with shiny ped faces, gradual clay change with depth.",
           "Common on basic rocks in the humid tropics."] },
  { id: "FR", step: "Iron and aluminium chemistry", q: "Is there a deeply weathered subsoil with very low-activity clays (ferralic horizon)?",
    help: ["A ferralic horizon starting within 150 cm.",
           "Lab cues: CEC (pH 7) below about 16 cmol(+)/kg clay, few weatherable minerals, little silt, weak structure that breaks to fine granules."] },
  { id: "MO", step: "Dark topsoils", q: "Is there a thick, dark, humus-rich mineral topsoil (mollic or umbric horizon)?",
    help: ["Dark colour: moist value and chroma of 3 or less, at least 0.6% organic carbon, usually 20 cm or more thick.",
           "Mollic = base saturation 50% or more; umbric = below 50%."], yes: "CH", no: "DU" },
  { id: "CH", step: "Dark topsoils", q: "Is the dark topsoil very dark (chernic), with secondary carbonates starting close below it?",
    help: ["A chernic horizon (moist chroma 2 or less, very dark, granular, 1% organic carbon or more).",
           "A calcic horizon or secondary carbonates starting within about 50 cm below the dark layer; base saturation 50% or more above them."], no: "KS" },
  { id: "KS", step: "Dark topsoils", q: "Are there secondary carbonates below the dark (mollic) topsoil?",
    help: ["A calcic horizon or secondary carbonates (white powdery coatings, nodules, soft masses) starting within about 70 cm below the mollic horizon.",
           "Base saturation 50% or more above them."], no: "PH" },
  { id: "PH", step: "Dark topsoils", q: "Is base saturation high (50% or more) through the profile, with no shallow carbonates?",
    help: ["A mollic horizon with base saturation (pH 7) of 50% or more down to about 100 cm (or to rock).",
           "If the dark topsoil is acid (low base saturation), answer No."], no: "UM" },
  { id: "UM", step: "Dark topsoils", q: "Is it a dark, humus-rich topsoil with low base saturation (umbric)?",
    help: ["An umbric horizon, or a dark topsoil whose base saturation is below 50%.",
           "If none of the dark-topsoil groups fit, answer No to continue the key."] },
  { id: "DU", step: "Accumulations", q: "Is there a layer cemented or enriched by secondary silica within 100 cm?",
    help: ["A duric horizon (silica nodules, 'durinodes') or petroduric horizon (duripan) starting within 100 cm."] },
  { id: "GY", step: "Accumulations", q: "Is there a layer of secondary gypsum within 100 cm?",
    help: ["A gypsic or petrogypsic horizon starting within 100 cm: visible gypsum crystals, pseudomycelia or cemented gypsum, usually 5% gypsum or more."] },
  { id: "CL", step: "Accumulations", q: "Is there a layer of secondary carbonate (lime) accumulation within 100 cm?",
    help: ["A calcic or petrocalcic horizon starting within 100 cm: white soft masses, nodules or a hardpan; fizzes strongly with dilute acid; usually 15% CaCO₃ equivalent or more."] },
  { id: "AR0", step: "Clay-enriched subsoils", q: "Is there a clay-enriched subsoil (argic horizon) within 100 cm?",
    help: ["Clearly more clay than the layer above: roughly 1.4 times more (or 6–8 percentage points more, depending on the clay content above), often with clay coatings on ped faces.",
           "If there is no clear clay increase, answer No."], yes: "RT", no: "CM" },
  { id: "RT", step: "Clay-enriched subsoils", q: "Does paler, coarser material tongue down into the clay-enriched subsoil (retic properties)?",
    help: ["Bleached, coarser-textured material interfingering into the argic horizon in vertical tongues or wedges.",
           "Typical of cool, humid forest soils."], no: "ACT" },
  { id: "ACT", step: "Clay-enriched subsoils", q: "Does the clay in the subsoil have low activity?",
    help: ["CEC (pH 7) below about 24 cmol(+)/kg clay in much of the argic horizon.",
           "Typical of strongly weathered, kaolinitic soils in warm climates."], yes: "BSL", no: "BSH" },
  { id: "BSL", step: "Clay-enriched subsoils", q: "Is the base saturation low (below 50%) in most of the subsoil?",
    help: ["Base saturation (pH 7) below 50% in most of the layer between about 50 and 100 cm.",
           "Yes → Acrisols; No → Lixisols."], yes: "=AC", no: "=LX" },
  { id: "BSH", step: "Clay-enriched subsoils", q: "Is the base saturation low (below 50%) in most of the subsoil?",
    help: ["Base saturation (pH 7) below 50% in most of the layer between about 50 and 100 cm; often high exchangeable aluminium.",
           "Yes → Alisols; No → Luvisols."], yes: "=AL", no: "=LV" },
  { id: "CM", step: "Little development", q: "Is there a subsurface horizon showing alteration (colour, structure or weathering) but no clay enrichment?",
    help: ["A cambic horizon starting within 50 cm and extending to at least 25 cm.",
           "Signs: redder or browner colour than below, soil structure instead of rock or sediment structure, removal of carbonates."] },
  { id: "FL", step: "Little development", q: "Is the soil in recent river, lake or marine deposits that still show their layering?",
    help: ["Fluvic material (visible stratification, or organic carbon that varies irregularly with depth) at least 25 cm thick, starting within about 25 cm.",
           "Typical of floodplains, deltas and coastal flats."] },
  { id: "AR", step: "Little development", q: "Is the soil sandy throughout?",
    help: ["Loamy sand or coarser texture (weighted average) down to 100 cm or to rock, with less than about 40% coarse fragments.",
           "Feels gritty and does not hold together in a ribbon."] }
];
// default flow: yes -> RSG with same code; no -> next question in order
const ORDER = Q.map(q => q.id), byId = Object.fromEntries(Q.map(q => [q.id, q]));
// Results are written "=CODE"; anything else is the id of the next question.
const nextOf = id => { const i = ORDER.indexOf(id); return i >= 0 && i < ORDER.length - 1 ? ORDER[i + 1] : "=RG"; };
const yesOf = q => q.yes || "=" + q.id;
const noOf = q => q.no || (q.id === "AR" ? "=RG" : nextOf(q.id));
byId.UM.no = "DU";

let path = []; // [{id, ans}]
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const view = $("view");
const total = 26;

function render() {
  const cur = currentNode();
  $("restart").hidden = !formMode && path.length === 0 && cur === "START";
  $("bar").style.width = (cur.startsWith("=") ? 100 : Math.min(95, path.length / total * 100)) + "%";
  if (formMode) return formResult ? showFormResult() : batch ? batchView() : formView();
  if (cur === "START") return intro();
  if (cur.startsWith("=")) return result(cur.slice(1));
  question(byId[cur]);
}
function currentNode() {
  if (!path.started) return "START";
  let node = "HS";
  for (const p of path) {
    const q = byId[p.id];
    node = p.ans === "y" ? yesOf(q) : noOf(q);
  }
  return node;
}
function intro() {
  view.innerHTML = `<div class="wk-card">
    <h1>Find the WRB Reference Soil Group</h1>
    <p>Two ways to work through the WRB 2022 key. Both follow its order, so the first group that fits is the answer.</p>
    <div class="modes">
      <button id="go"><b>Step by step</b><span>Answer one yes/no question at a time. Best in the field.</span></button>
      <button id="goform"><b>Enter profile data</b><span>Fill in field observations and lab data for each horizon, and the app decides.</span></button>
    </div>
    <ul class="intro" style="margin-top:16px"><li>Choose <b>Not sure</b> or leave a box empty when you don't know. The key carries on and tells you what to check.</li></ul></div>`;
  $("go").onclick = () => { path.started = true; render(); };
  $("goform").onclick = () => { formMode = true; render(); };
}
function question(q) {
  const n = path.length + 1;
  view.innerHTML = `<div class="step">${q.step} · Question ${n}</div>
    <div class="wk-card">
      <h1>${q.q}</h1>
      <div class="answers">
        <button class="yes" data-a="y">Yes</button>
        <button data-a="n">No</button>
        <button class="unsure" data-a="u">Not sure</button>
      </div>
      <details><summary>How to check</summary><ul>${q.help.map(h => `<li>${h}</li>`).join("")}</ul></details>
    </div>
    <div class="wk-nav"><button id="back" ${path.length ? "" : "hidden"}>← Back</button><span></span></div>`;
  view.querySelectorAll("[data-a]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { path.push({ id: q.id, ans: b.dataset.a }); render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); });
  const back = $("back"); if (back) back.onclick = () => { path.pop(); render(); };
}
function result(code) {
  const [name, desc] = RSG[code];
  const unsure = path.filter(p => p.ans === "u");
  // groups that would have been assigned if an unsure answer had been Yes
  const alts = unsure.map(p => { const q = byId[p.id], y = yesOf(q); return { q, to: y.startsWith("=") ? RSG[y.slice(1)][0] : null }; });
  view.innerHTML = `<div class="step">Result</div>
    <div class="wk-card result">
      <span class="code">${code}</span>
      <div class="rsg">${name}</div>
      <p>${desc}</p>
      ${unsure.length ? `<div class="flag"><strong>Provisional.</strong> You weren't sure about ${unsure.length} question${unsure.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} earlier in the key, so check ${unsure.length > 1 ? "these" : "this"} first:<ul style="margin:8px 0 0; padding-left:18px">${alts.map(a => `<li>${a.q.q}${a.to ? ` If yes, the soil would key out as <b>${a.to}</b> instead.` : " If yes, the key would follow a different branch from that point."}</li>`).join("")}</ul></div>` : ""}
      <div class="trail"><h2 style="margin-top:14px">Your answers</h2>${path.map(p => `<div><span>${byId[p.id].q}</span><span class="a ${p.ans}">${p.ans === "y" ? "Yes" : p.ans === "n" ? "No" : "Not sure"}</span></div>`).join("")}</div>
      <div id="qhost"></div>
      <button class="primary" id="again">Classify another profile</button>
      <button class="secondary" id="back2">← Change last answer</button>
    </div>`;
  QS = { principal: [], supplementary: [] }; $("qhost").appendChild(qualBox(code, null));
  $("again").onclick = () => { path = []; QS = { principal: [], supplementary: [] }; path.started = true; render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); };
  $("back2").onclick = () => { path.pop(); render(); };
}

/* ---------------- qualifiers (beta) ---------------- */
const QUAL_NAMES = ["Abruptic","Acric","Albic","Alic","Andic","Arenic","Calcaric","Calcic","Cambic","Chromic","Clayic","Cutanic","Densic","Dolomitic","Duric","Dystric","Eutric","Ferralic","Ferric","Fluvic","Fractic","Geric","Gleyic","Gypsic","Gypsiric","Haplic","Humic","Hyperdystric","Hypereutric","Leptic","Lixic","Loamic","Luvic","Mollic","Nitic","Ochric","Petric","Petrocalcic","Petroplinthic","Pisoplinthic","Plinthic","Profondic","Protic","Rhodic","Salic","Siltic","Skeletic","Sodic","Stagnic","Umbric","Vertic","Vitric","Xanthic"];
let QS = { principal: [], supplementary: [] };
function wavg(hz, f, z1, z2) { let s = 0, w = 0; hz.forEach(h => { if (h[f] === "" || h[f] == null || !isFinite(h[f]) || h.top === "" || h.bottom === "") return; const o = Math.max(0, Math.min(h.bottom, z2) - Math.max(h.top, z1)); if (o > 0) { s += h[f] * o; w += o; } }); return w > 0 ? { v: s / w, cover: w / (z2 - z1) } : null; }
function suggestQualifiers(hz) {
  const out = [];
  const bs = wavg(hz, "bs", 20, 100);
  if (bs && bs.cover >= 0.5) out.push(bs.v < 50 ? ["Dystric", `base saturation ${bs.v.toFixed(0)}% (weighted, 20–100 cm)`] : ["Eutric", `base saturation ${bs.v.toFixed(0)}% (weighted, 20–100 cm)`]);
  if (hz.some(h => isFinite(h.caco3) && h.caco3 !== "" && h.caco3 >= 2 && h.top < 50 && h.bottom > 20)) out.push(["Calcaric", "CaCO₃ ≥ 2% between 20 and 50 cm"]);
  const oc = wavg(hz, "oc", 0, 50);
  if (oc && oc.cover >= 0.8 && oc.v >= 1) out.push(["Humic", `organic C ${oc.v.toFixed(1)}% (weighted, 0–50 cm)`]);
  const cf = wavg(hz, "cf", 0, 100);
  if (cf && cf.cover >= 0.5 && cf.v >= 40) out.push(["Skeletic", `coarse fragments ${cf.v.toFixed(0)}% (weighted, 0–100 cm)`]);
  if (hz.some(h => isFinite(h.ec) && h.ec !== "" && h.ec >= 15 && h.top < 100)) out.push(["Salic", "EC ≥ 15 dS/m within 100 cm"]);
  return out;
}
function qualName(code) {
  // principal qualifiers are written before the name, the first one listed closest to it
  const pr = QS.principal.slice().reverse().join(" "), su = QS.supplementary.length ? ` (${QS.supplementary.join(", ")})` : "";
  return `${pr ? pr + " " : ""}${RSG[code][0]}${su}`;
}
function qualBox(code, sugg) {
  const host = document.createElement("div"); host.className = "qual";
  const draw = () => {
    const chips = kind => QS[kind].map((q, i) => `<span class="chip">${q}<button data-rm="${kind}:${i}" aria-label="Remove ${q}">✕</button></span>`).join("") || `<span style="color:var(--ink-3); font-size:.85rem">None yet</span>`;
    host.innerHTML = `<h2>Qualifiers <span class="beta">Beta</span></h2>
      <p class="warn">For advanced users. Each Reference Soil Group has its own list of allowed qualifiers and rules in WRB 2022 (Chapter 4). Check every qualifier against that list. This does not replace a qualified soil scientist.</p>
      <div class="qname" id="qname">${qualName(code)}</div>
      <div class="row2" style="margin-top:0"><button class="secondary" id="qcopy" style="margin:0">Copy name</button></div>
      ${sugg && sugg.length ? `<h2 style="margin-top:14px; font-size:.95rem">Suggested from your data</h2>${sugg.map(([n, why]) => `<div class="sugg"><button data-sug="${n}">Add</button><span><b style="color:var(--ink)">${n}</b> · ${why}. Check it's on the ${RSG[code][0]} list.</span></div>`).join("")}` : ""}
      <h2 style="margin-top:14px; font-size:.95rem">Principal qualifiers</h2><div class="chips">${chips("principal")}</div>
      <h2 style="font-size:.95rem">Supplementary qualifiers</h2><div class="chips">${chips("supplementary")}</div>
      <div class="qadd"><input id="qin" list="qlist" placeholder="Qualifier name, e.g. Rhodic" autocomplete="off"><select id="qkind" aria-label="Qualifier type"><option value="principal">Principal</option><option value="supplementary">Supplementary</option></select></div>
      <button class="secondary" id="qaddbtn">Add qualifier</button>
      <datalist id="qlist">${QUAL_NAMES.map(n => `<option value="${n}">`).join("")}</datalist>
      <p class="hint" style="font-size:.8rem; color:var(--ink-3); margin-top:10px">Add principal qualifiers in the order of the group's list; the first is written closest to the group name. Supplementary qualifiers go in brackets after the name.</p>`;
    host.querySelectorAll("[data-rm]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const [k, i] = b.dataset.rm.split(":"); QS[k].splice(+i, 1); draw(); });
    host.querySelectorAll("[data-sug]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const n = b.dataset.sug; if (!QS.principal.includes(n) && !QS.supplementary.includes(n)) QS.principal.push(n); draw(); });
    host.querySelector("#qaddbtn").onclick = () => {
      let n = host.querySelector("#qin").value.trim(); if (!n) return;
      n = n.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + n.slice(1).toLowerCase();
      const k = host.querySelector("#qkind").value; if (!QS.principal.includes(n) && !QS.supplementary.includes(n)) QS[k].push(n); draw();
    };
    host.querySelector("#qcopy").onclick = async () => { const t = qualName(code); try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t); host.querySelector("#qcopy").textContent = "Copied"; } catch (e) { host.querySelector("#qcopy").textContent = t; } };
  };
  draw(); return host;
}

/* ---------------- form mode ---------------- */
let formMode = false, formResult = null;
const SITE_Q = [
  ["Organic soils and human influence", [
    ["organicCm", "num", "Organic layer (peat/muck) thickness within 100 cm (cm)"],
    ["anthric", "yn", "Thick human-made topsoil (≥ 50 cm of hortic, irragric, plaggic, pretic or terric; or wet-rice puddling)?"],
    ["artefacts", "yn", "≥ 20% artefacts in the upper 100 cm, or sealed / technical surface?"],
    ["permafrost", "yn", "Permafrost within 100 cm?"]]],
  ["Root limitations", [
    ["rock", "rock", "Continuous hard rock within 100 cm?"],
    ["slickensides", "yn", "Slickensides or wedge-shaped aggregates within 100 cm (shrink–swell cracking)?"],
    ["saline", "yn", "Strongly salty near the surface (used if no EC data)?"],
    ["sodic", "yn", "Dense, sodium-rich (natric) subsoil within 100 cm (used if no ESP data)?"]]],
  ["Water and iron–aluminium features", [
    ["gleyic", "yn", "Groundwater gleying (gleyic properties) starting within ~40 cm, or under water / tidal?"],
    ["andic", "yn", "Andic or vitric (volcanic) properties near the surface?"],
    ["spodic", "yn", "Spodic horizon (humus / Fe–Al accumulation) within 200 cm?"],
    ["plinthic", "yn", "Plinthite, ironstone or iron concretions (plinthic / petroplinthic / pisoplinthic) within 50 cm?"],
    ["stagnic", "yn", "Perched-water mottling (stagnic properties) starting within ~60 cm?"],
    ["nitic", "yn", "Nitic structure: strong nutty blocks with shiny ped faces?"],
    ["ferralic", "yn", "Ferralic horizon (used if no CEC data)?"]]],
  ["Accumulations and development", [
    ["duric", "yn", "Secondary silica (duric / petroduric) within 100 cm?"],
    ["gypsic", "yn", "Secondary gypsum layer within 100 cm (used if no gypsum data)?"],
    ["calcic", "yn", "Secondary carbonate (calcic) layer within 100 cm (used if no CaCO₃ data)?"],
    ["retic", "yn", "Paler, coarser material tonguing into a clay-enriched subsoil (retic)?"],
    ["cambic", "yn", "Subsoil horizon showing alteration (cambic) within 50 cm?"],
    ["fluvic", "yn", "Fluvic stratification (river, lake or marine layering) near the surface?"]]]
];
const HZ_F = [
  ["top", "Top (cm)"], ["bottom", "Bottom (cm)"], ["clay", "Clay %"], ["sand", "Sand %"],
  ["cf", "Coarse fragments % vol"], ["oc", "Organic C %"], ["value", "Munsell value (moist)", "v"], ["chroma", "Munsell chroma (moist)", "c"],
  ["cec", "CEC pH 7 (cmol/kg soil)"], ["bs", "Base saturation %"], ["esp", "ESP %"], ["ec", "EC (dS/m)"],
  ["caco3", "CaCO₃ equiv. %"], ["gypsum", "Gypsum %"]
];
let F = { site: {}, hz: [{ top: 0, bottom: 20 }, { top: 20, bottom: 50 }, { top: 50, bottom: 100 }] };
const EXAMPLE = { site: { organicCm: 0, anthric: "n", artefacts: "n", permafrost: "n", rock: "none", slickensides: "n", saline: "n", sodic: "n", gleyic: "n", andic: "n", spodic: "n", plinthic: "n", stagnic: "n", nitic: "n", duric: "n", gypsic: "n", calcic: "n", retic: "n", cambic: "n", fluvic: "n" },
  hz: [{ top: 0, bottom: 15, clay: 12, sand: 70, cf: 5, oc: 1.1, value: 4, chroma: 3, cec: 4, bs: 65 },
       { top: 15, bottom: 35, clay: 14, sand: 66, cf: 5, oc: 0.6, value: 5, chroma: 4, cec: 3.5, bs: 60 },
       { top: 35, bottom: 110, clay: 28, sand: 52, cf: 8, oc: 0.3, value: 4, chroma: 6, cec: 5, bs: 70 }] };
const ynSel = (k, v) => `<select data-site="${k}"><option value="" ${!v ? "selected" : ""}>Not sure</option><option value="y" ${v === "y" ? "selected" : ""}>Yes</option><option value="n" ${v === "n" ? "selected" : ""}>No</option></select>`;
/* ---------------- CSV upload (soilKey column names) ---------------- */
let batch = null;
function parseCSVText(t) {
  const lines = t.replace(/\r/g, "").split("\n").filter(l => l.trim());
  if (!lines.length) return { head: [], rows: [] };
  const sep = lines[0].includes("\t") ? "\t" : (lines[0].split(";").length > lines[0].split(",").length ? ";" : ",");
  const split = l => { const o = []; let c = "", q = false; for (let i = 0; i < l.length; i++) { const ch = l[i]; if (ch === '"') { if (q && l[i + 1] === '"') { c += '"'; i++; } else q = !q; } else if (ch === sep && !q) { o.push(c.trim()); c = ""; } else c += ch; } o.push(c.trim()); return o; };
  return { head: split(lines[0]).map(h => h.toLowerCase()), rows: lines.slice(1).map(split) };
}
const SK_MAP = { top_cm: "top", bottom_cm: "bottom", clay_pct: "clay", sand_pct: "sand", coarse_fragments_pct: "cf", oc_pct: "oc",
  munsell_value_moist: "value", munsell_chroma_moist: "chroma", cec_cmol: "cec", bs_pct: "bs", ec_dS_m: "ec", ec_ds_m: "ec", caco3_pct: "caco3", caso4_pct: "gypsum" };
const SITE_COLS = ["gleyic", "stagnic", "andic", "spodic", "nitic", "retic", "cambic", "fluvic", "duric", "anthric", "permafrost", "saline", "sodic", "gypsic", "calcic", "ferralic", "artefacts", "plinthic", "slickensides"];
function csvToProfiles(text) {
  const { head, rows } = parseCSVText(text);
  const ix = n => head.indexOf(n);
  if (ix("top_cm") < 0 || ix("bottom_cm") < 0) throw new Error("Columns top_cm and bottom_cm are required (soilKey names).");
  const num = v => { if (v === undefined || v === null) return ""; const s = String(v).trim(); if (s === "" || s.toUpperCase() === "NA") return ""; const n = Number(s); return isFinite(n) ? n : ""; };
  const groups = new Map();
  rows.forEach((r, k) => { const id = ix("id") >= 0 ? (r[ix("id")] || "profile") : "profile"; if (!groups.has(id)) groups.set(id, []); groups.get(id).push(r); });
  return [...groups.entries()].map(([id, rs]) => {
    const hz = rs.map(r => {
      const h = {};
      Object.entries(SK_MAP).forEach(([c, f]) => { if (ix(c) >= 0) h[f] = num(r[ix(c)]); });
      // base saturation and ESP from exchangeable cations when given
      const ca = num(r[ix("ca_cmol")]), mg = num(r[ix("mg_cmol")]), k = num(r[ix("k_cmol")]), na = num(r[ix("na_cmol")]);
      if ((h.bs === "" || h.bs === undefined) && [ca, mg, k, na].every(v => v !== "") && h.cec > 0) h.bs = 100 * (ca + mg + k + na) / h.cec;
      if (na !== "" && h.cec > 0) h.esp = 100 * na / h.cec;
      h._slick = ix("slickensides") >= 0 ? (r[ix("slickensides")] || "").toLowerCase() : "";
      h._art = ix("artefacts_pct") >= 0 ? num(r[ix("artefacts_pct")]) : "";
      h._plin = ix("plinthite_pct") >= 0 ? num(r[ix("plinthite_pct")]) : "";
      return h;
    }).filter(h => h.top !== "" && h.bottom !== "");
    const site = {};
    const first = rs[0], val = c => ix(c) >= 0 ? (first[ix(c)] || "").trim().toLowerCase() : "";
    SITE_COLS.forEach(c => { const v = val(c); if (v === "y" || v === "yes" || v === "true") site[c] = "y"; else if (v === "n" || v === "no" || v === "false") site[c] = "n"; });
    // morphology columns from the horizons
    const slick = hz.filter(h => h.top < 100 && h._slick);
    if (slick.length && !site.slickensides) site.slickensides = slick.some(h => !["absent", "none", "0", "no"].includes(h._slick)) ? "y" : "n";
    const art = hz.filter(h => h.top < 100 && h._art !== "");
    if (art.length && !site.artefacts) { const w = art.reduce((s, h) => s + (Math.min(h.bottom, 100) - h.top), 0), m = art.reduce((s, h) => s + h._art * (Math.min(h.bottom, 100) - h.top), 0) / w; site.artefacts = m >= 20 ? "y" : "n"; }
    const pl = hz.filter(h => h.top < 50 && h._plin !== "");
    if (pl.length && !site.plinthic) site.plinthic = pl.some(h => h._plin >= 15) ? "y" : "n";
    if (ix("rock_cm") >= 0) { const v = (first[ix("rock_cm")] || "").trim().toLowerCase(); site.rock = v === "none" ? "none" : (num(v) !== "" ? num(v) : ""); }
    if (ix("organic_cm") >= 0 && num(first[ix("organic_cm")]) !== "") site.organicCm = num(first[ix("organic_cm")]);
    return { id, site, hz };
  });
}
function batchView() {
  view.innerHTML = `<div class="step">Results · ${batch.length} profile${batch.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}</div><div class="wk-card">
    <h1 style="font-size:1.2rem">Classified profiles</h1>
    <p>Tap a profile to see how the key ran. <b>Provisional</b> means groups earlier in the key couldn't be checked with the columns provided.</p>
    ${batch.map((b, i) => `<div class="chk" style="grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; cursor:pointer" data-open="${i}"><span class="t"><b>${b.id}</b> · ${RSG[b.r.code][0]}</span><span class="s ${b.r.unsure.length ? "u" : "y"}">${b.r.unsure.length ? "Provisional" : "Checked"}</span></div>`).join("")}
    <button class="primary" id="dlcsv">Download results (CSV)</button>
    <button class="secondary" id="bback">← Back to the form</button></div>`;
  view.querySelectorAll("[data-open]").forEach(e => e.onclick = () => { const b = batch[+e.dataset.open]; F = { site: b.site, hz: b.hz }; formResult = b.r; formResult._fromBatch = true; render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); });
  $("bback").onclick = () => { batch = null; render(); };
  $("dlcsv").onclick = () => {
    const esc = v => /[",\n]/.test(String(v)) ? '"' + String(v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : v;
    const lines = [["id", "rsg_code", "rsg", "status", "groups_not_checked"].join(",")].concat(batch.map(b => [b.id, b.r.code, RSG[b.r.code][0], b.r.unsure.length ? "provisional" : "checked", b.r.unsure.map(u => RSG[u.code][0]).join("; ")].map(esc).join(",")));
    const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([lines.join("\n")], { type: "text/csv" })); a.download = "wrb_key_results.csv"; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); setTimeout(() => a.remove(), 500);
  };
}

function formView() {
  const site = F.site;
  let h = `<div class="step">Enter profile data</div>
    <div class="wk-card"><h1 style="font-size:1.15rem">Upload a CSV</h1>
      <p>One row per horizon, using the soilKey R package column names, so the same file works in both. Add an <b>id</b> column to classify several profiles at once.</p>
      <label class="secondary" style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-top:4px">Choose CSV file<input type="file" id="csvin" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt" style="display:none"></label>
      <details><summary>Columns it reads</summary><ul>
        <li><b>Required:</b> top_cm, bottom_cm</li>
        <li><b>Lab:</b> clay_pct, sand_pct, coarse_fragments_pct, oc_pct, cec_cmol, bs_pct (or ca_cmol, mg_cmol, k_cmol, na_cmol), ec_dS_m, caco3_pct, caso4_pct</li>
        <li><b>Colour:</b> munsell_value_moist, munsell_chroma_moist</li>
        <li><b>Morphology:</b> slickensides (absent / few / common / many), artefacts_pct, plinthite_pct</li>
        <li><b>Optional field calls</b> (y / n, one per profile): gleyic, stagnic, andic, spodic, nitic, retic, cambic, fluvic, duric, anthric, permafrost, rock_cm (depth to rock), organic_cm</li>
        <li>Other columns are ignored, so a full soilKey file works as it is.</li></ul></details>
      <div class="msg" id="csvmsg" style="font-size:.9rem; margin-top:8px; color:var(--warn)"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="wk-card"><h1 style="font-size:1.25rem">Or fill in by hand: field observations</h1>
    <p>Leave anything you don't know as <b>Not sure</b>.</p>`;
  SITE_Q.forEach(([sec, qs]) => {
    h += `<div class="sec">${sec}</div><div class="fgrid one">`;
    qs.forEach(([k, type, lab]) => {
      if (type === "num") h += `<div class="fld"><label>${lab}</label><input type="number" inputmode="decimal" data-site="${k}" value="${site[k] ?? ""}" placeholder="Not recorded"></div>`;
      else if (type === "rock") {
        const mode = site.rock === "none" ? "n" : (site.rock === "y" || typeof site.rock === "number") ? "y" : "";
        h += `<div class="fld"><label>${lab}</label><select data-rock><option value="" ${!mode ? "selected" : ""}>Not sure</option><option value="y" ${mode === "y" ? "selected" : ""}>Yes</option><option value="n" ${mode === "n" ? "selected" : ""}>No</option></select>
          ${mode === "y" ? `<input type="number" inputmode="decimal" data-site="rock" value="${typeof site.rock === "number" ? site.rock : ""}" placeholder="Depth to rock (cm)" style="margin-top:6px">` : ""}</div>`;
      } else h += `<div class="fld"><label>${lab}</label>${ynSel(k, site[k])}</div>`;
    });
    h += `</div>`;
  });
  h += `</div><div class="sec">Horizons (lab data)</div>`;
  F.hz.forEach((z, i) => {
    h += `<div class="hcard"><div class="hd">Horizon ${i + 1}${F.hz.length > 1 ? `<button data-del="${i}">Remove</button>` : ""}</div><div class="fgrid">`;
    HZ_F.forEach(([k, lab, sel]) => {
      if (sel) { const opts = sel === "v" ? [1, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] : [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8];
        h += `<div class="fld"><label>${lab}</label><select data-hz="${i}" data-k="${k}"><option value="">–</option>${opts.map(o => `<option ${z[k] == o ? "selected" : ""}>${o}</option>`).join("")}</select></div>`; }
      else h += `<div class="fld"><label>${lab}</label><input type="number" inputmode="decimal" step="any" data-hz="${i}" data-k="${k}" value="${z[k] ?? ""}"></div>`;
    });
    h += `</div></div>`;
  });
  h += `<div class="row2"><button class="secondary" id="addhz" style="margin:0">+ Add horizon</button><button class="secondary" id="ex" style="margin:0">Load example</button></div>
    <button class="primary" id="classify">Classify</button><div class="wk-nav"><button id="fback">← Back</button><span></span></div>`;
  view.innerHTML = h;
  view.querySelectorAll("[data-site]").forEach(e => e.oninput = () => { const v = e.value, k = e.dataset.site; F.site[k] = e.type === "number" ? (v === "" ? (k === "rock" ? "y" : "") : +v) : v; });
  const rk = view.querySelector("[data-rock]"); rk.onchange = () => { F.site.rock = rk.value === "n" ? "none" : rk.value === "y" ? (typeof F.site.rock === "number" ? F.site.rock : "y") : ""; formView(); };
  view.querySelectorAll("[data-hz]").forEach(e => e.oninput = () => { const v = e.value; F.hz[+e.dataset.hz][e.dataset.k] = v === "" ? "" : +v; });
  view.querySelectorAll("[data-del]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { F.hz.splice(+b.dataset.del, 1); formView(); });
  $("addhz").onclick = () => { const last = F.hz[F.hz.length - 1]; F.hz.push({ top: last && last.bottom !== "" ? last.bottom : "", bottom: "" }); formView(); };
  $("ex").onclick = () => { F = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(EXAMPLE)); formView(); };
  $("classify").onclick = () => { formResult = WRBEngine.classify(F.site, F.hz); render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); };
  $("csvin").onchange = e => {
    const f = e.target.files[0]; if (!f) return;
    const rd = new FileReader();
    rd.onload = () => {
      try {
        const profs = csvToProfiles(rd.result);
        if (!profs.length) throw new Error("No horizons with top_cm and bottom_cm found.");
        batch = profs.map(p => ({ ...p, r: WRBEngine.classify(p.site, p.hz) }));
        if (batch.length === 1) { F = { site: batch[0].site, hz: batch[0].hz }; formResult = batch[0].r; batch = null; }
        render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      } catch (err) { $("csvmsg").textContent = err.message; }
    };
    rd.readAsText(f);
  };
  $("fback").onclick = () => { formMode = false; render(); };
}
function showFormResult() {
  const r = formResult, [name, desc] = RSG[r.code];
  const sym = ok => ok === true ? ["✓", "y"] : ok === false ? ["✗", "n"] : ["?", "u"];
  view.innerHTML = `<div class="step">Result</div><div class="wk-card result">
    <span class="code">${r.code}</span><div class="rsg">${name}</div><p>${desc}</p>
    ${r.unsure.length ? `<div class="flag"><strong>Provisional.</strong> ${r.unsure.length} group${r.unsure.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} earlier in the key couldn't be checked with the data given. If any of these apply, the soil would key out there instead:<ul style="margin:8px 0 0; padding-left:18px">${r.unsure.map(u => `<li><b>${RSG[u.code][0]}</b>: ${u.note}</li>`).join("")}</ul></div>` : ""}
    <h2 style="margin-top:16px">How the key ran</h2>
    ${r.trail.map(t => { const [g, c] = sym(t.ok); return `<div class="chk"><span class="s ${c}">${g}</span><span class="t"><b>${RSG[t.code][0]}</b> · ${t.note}</span></div>`; }).join("")}
    <div id="qhost"></div>
    <button class="primary" id="edit">Edit the data</button>
    <button class="secondary" id="new">Classify another profile</button></div>`;
  QS = { principal: [], supplementary: [] }; $("qhost").appendChild(qualBox(r.code, suggestQualifiers(F.hz)));
  if (formResult._fromBatch) { $("edit").textContent = "← Back to all profiles"; $("edit").onclick = () => { formResult = null; render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); }; } else $("edit").onclick = () => { formResult = null; render(); };
  $("new").onclick = () => { formResult = null; batch = null; F = { site: {}, hz: [{ top: 0, bottom: 20 }, { top: 20, bottom: 50 }, { top: 50, bottom: 100 }] }; render(); window.scrollTo(0, 0); };
}

$("restart").onclick = () => { path = []; formMode = false; formResult = null; batch = null; render(); };
render();
})();
</script>
</div>
</div>
<div class="keypane" data-pane="sa" hidden>
<style>

.sakey {
  
  --bg: #161412; --surface: #1f1c19; --surface-2: #2a2622; --ink: #f0ece4; --ink-2: #c4bdb1; --ink-3: #8f887d;
  --line: #3a352f; --accent: #d98b56; --accent-ink: #1a1410; --accent-soft: #3a2a1f; --warn: #e0a440; --good: #5cc28f;
  color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.55;
}
body.quarto-light .sakey {
    
    --bg: #f7f5f0; --surface: #fffdf9; --surface-2: #efebe2; --ink: #1f1c17; --ink-2: #57514a; --ink-3: #8a8379;
    --line: #ddd6ca; --accent: #8a4b22; --accent-ink: #ffffff; --accent-soft: #f3e6da; --warn: #9a6400; --good: #1f7a4d;
}
.sakey * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.sakey .wk-app { max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 0 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.sakey header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 0 10px; }
.sakey header .brand { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.sakey header .brand span { color: var(--accent); }
.sakey header button { background: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink-2); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sakey .wk-progress { height: 4px; background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; margin: 4px 0 6px; }
.sakey .wk-progress div { height: 100%; background: var(--accent); transition: width .25s ease; }
.sakey .step { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--ink-3); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 14px; }
.sakey .wk-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 18px; margin-top: 10px; }
.sakey h1 { font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.25; margin: 6px 0 12px; }
.sakey h2 { font-size: 1.1rem; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.sakey p { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.sakey .answers { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin-top: 18px; }
.sakey .answers button {
  width: 100%; min-height: 54px; border-radius: 12px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink);
}
.sakey .answers button.yes { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.sakey .answers button.unsure { background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 500; }
.sakey details { margin-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 12px; }
.sakey summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; list-style: none; }
.sakey summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.sakey summary::before { content: "＋ "; }
.sakey details[open] summary::before { content: "－ "; }
.sakey details ul { margin: 10px 0 0; padding-left: 20px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: .93rem; }
.sakey details li { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.sakey .wk-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 14px; }
.sakey .wk-nav button { background: none; border: none; color: var(--ink-2); font: inherit; font-size: .95rem; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 0; }
.sakey .result .rsg { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 2px 0 4px; }
.sakey .result .code { display: inline-block; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; }
.sakey .flag { border: 1px solid var(--warn); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 12%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; margin-top: 14px; font-size: .93rem; }
.sakey .flag strong { color: var(--warn); }
.sakey .trail { margin-top: 14px; font-size: .9rem; }
.sakey .trail div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink-2); }
.sakey .trail span.a { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.sakey .trail span.a.y { color: var(--good); }
.sakey .trail span.a.u { color: var(--warn); }
.sakey .primary { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: inherit; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 16px; cursor: pointer; }
.sakey .secondary { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; margin-top: 10px; cursor: pointer; }
.sakey .foot { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 22px; font-size: .78rem; color: var(--ink-3); }
.sakey .foot a { color: var(--accent); }
.sakey .beta { font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--warn); border: 1px solid var(--warn); border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 7px; vertical-align: 2px; margin-left: 4px; }
.sakey .qual { margin-top: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; background: var(--surface-2); }
.sakey .qual h2 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.sakey .qual .warn { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--warn); margin: 0 0 10px; }
.sakey .qname { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; margin: 8px 0; word-break: break-word; }
.sakey .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 6px 0 10px; }
.sakey .chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: .85rem; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); }
.sakey .chip button { background: none; border: none; color: var(--ink-3); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; padding: 0; }
.sakey .sugg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 8px; align-items: start; padding: 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .88rem; color: var(--ink-2); }
.sakey .sugg button { border: 1px solid var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 9px; font: inherit; font-size: .82rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sakey .qadd { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }
.sakey .qadd input, .sakey .qadd select { font: inherit; font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 10px; width: 100%; }
.sakey .qadd button { border: none; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border-radius: 9px; padding: 0 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
.sakey .modes { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin-top: 16px; }
.sakey .modes button { text-align: left; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.sakey .modes button b { display: block; font-size: 1.02rem; }
.sakey .modes button span { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: .9rem; }
.sakey .fgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px 12px; }
.sakey .fgrid.one { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.sakey .fld label { display: block; font-size: .82rem; color: var(--ink-2); margin-bottom: 3px; }
.sakey .fld select, .sakey .fld input { width: 100%; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 10px; }
.sakey .sec { font-size: .78rem; color: var(--ink-3); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; font-weight: 600; margin: 22px 0 6px; }
.sakey .hcard { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; margin-top: 10px; }
.sakey .hcard .hd { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 700; }
.sakey .hcard .hd button { background: none; border: none; color: var(--ink-3); font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sakey .row2 { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }
.sakey .row2 button { flex: 1; }
.sakey .chk { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .9rem; }
.sakey .chk .s { font-weight: 700; }
.sakey .chk .s.y { color: var(--good); }
.sakey .chk .s.n { color: var(--ink-3); }
.sakey .chk .s.u { color: var(--warn); }
.sakey .chk .t { color: var(--ink-2); }
.sakey .chk .t b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
.sakey .intro li { color: var(--ink-2); margin-bottom: 6px; }


.sakey header button { background: none; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink-2); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sakey .answers button.yes b { color: inherit; }

</style>
<div class="sakey">
<div class="wk-app">
  <header style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:6px 0 10px">
    <div class="brand"><span class="beta" style="margin-left:0">Beta</span> <span style="font-weight:400; font-size:.85rem; color:var(--ink-3)">Learning and field aid</span></div>
    <button id="sa-restart" hidden>Start over</button>
  </header>
  <main id="sa-view"></main>
  <div class="foot"><a href="tools.html">← Back to Tools</a><br>
    <b>Beta.</b> An unofficial aid that implements the soil form key and family tables of <i>Soil Classification: A Natural and Anthropogenic System for South Africa</i> (Soil Classification Working Group, 2018, ARC-Institute for Soil, Climate and Water, Pretoria). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ARC or the Soil Classification Working Group, and it does not replace the book or classification by a qualified soil scientist. Horizon and family descriptions here are brief summaries; the full diagnostic definitions in the book always apply.</div>
</div>

"s2": "-", "name": "Rooiberg", "code": "Ro", "page": 125, "fam": [{"name": "Topsoil colour", "pos": 0, "options": ["Dark topsoil", "Chromic topsoil", "Grey (bleached) topsoil"]}]}, {"t": "Orthic", "s1": "Dorbank", "s2": "-", "name": "Knersvlakte", "code": "Kn", "page": 126, "fam": [{"name": "Topsoil colour", "pos": 0, "options": ["Dark topsoil", "Chromic topsoil", "Grey (bleached) topsoil"]}, {"name": "Occurrence of lime and sepiolite", "pos": 1, "options": ["Non-calcareous without sepiolite", "Non-calcareous with sepiolite", "Calcareous without sepiolite", "Calcareous with sepiolite"]}]}, {"t": "Orthic", "s1": "Alluvial", "s2": "THICK", "name": "Dundee", "code": "Du", "page": 126, "fam": [{"name": "Topsoil colour", "pos": 0, "options": ["Dark topsoil", "Chromic topsoil", "Grey alluvial", "Calcareous alluvial"]}, {"name": "Alluvial wetness", "pos": 3, "options": ["Alluvial wetness absent", "Alluvial wetness present"]}]}, {"t": "Orthic", "s1": "Unconsolidated Material with Wetness", "s2": "THICK", "name": "Lepellane", "code": "Lp", "page": 127, "fam": [{"name": "Topsoil colour", "pos": 0, "options": ["Dark topsoil", "Chromic topsoil", "Grey (bleached) topsoil"]},
