of lithic weathering", "pos": 2, "options": ["Saprolithic below topsoil", "Geolithic below topsoil", "Gleylithic below topsoil"]}]}, {"t": "Orthic", "s1": "Hard Rock", "s2": "-", "name": "Mispah", "code": "Ms", "page": 128, "fam": [{"name": "Topsoil colour", "pos": 0, "options": ["Dark topsoil", "Chromic topsoil", "Grey (bleached) topsoil"]}, {"name": "Occurrence of lime", "pos": 1, "options": ["Non-calcareous topsoil", "Calcareous topsoil"]}, {"name": "Extent of rock weathering", "pos": 2, "options": ["Fractured rock", "Solid rock"]}]}];
const TOPS = ["Peat", "Organic", "Vertic", "Melanic", "Humic", "Orthic"];
/* Short descriptions in our own words, summarising the book's diagnostic criteria (Section A5). */
const HZ = {
  "Peat": "Waterlogged surface layer with more than 20% organic carbon, in a wetland setting.",
  "Organic": "Wet surface layer with 10–20% organic carbon.",
  "Vertic": "Dark, strongly structured clay topsoil (≥ 30% clay) that cracks, shows slickensides or wedge-shaped peds, or is self-mulching.",
  "Melanic": "Dark (dry value and chroma ≤ 3, not reddish), moderate to strong blocky structure, no slickensides, base-rich (≥ 4 cmol(+) exchangeable cations per kg clay for each 1% organic C), under 10% organic C.",
  "Humic": "Dark, carbon-rich (> 1.8% organic C throughout), weak structure, leached (< 4 cmol(+) per kg clay for each 1% organic C), freely drained.",
  "Orthic": "Any topsoil that is not peat, organic, vertic, melanic or humic. It may still be dark, chromic or bleached.",
  "Gley": "Grey to blue-grey matrix, weak or no structure, few mottles; often wet.",
  "Albic": "Light grey (bleached) matrix in the dry state, weak or no structure, fewer than 10% mottles.",
  "Gleyic": "Structured horizon with grey ped exteriors and brighter, mottled ped interiors (a redox pattern).",
  "Yellow-Brown Apedal": "Uniform yellow-brown colours, weak or no structure, not calcareous.",
  "Red Apedal": "Uniform red colours, weak or no structure, not calcareous.",
  "Red Structured": "Uniform red colours with moderate to strong structure and red cutans; no slickensides.",
  "Soft Plinthic": "More than 10% red, yellow-brown or black Fe/Mn mottles, with grey colours in or just below the horizon; weak structure; not cemented.",
  "Hard Plinthic": "Cemented ironstone, or a near-continuous sheet of iron/manganese concretions.",
  "Podzol": "Layer enriched in iron, aluminium and humus, often dark; mainly in the southern Cape.",
  "Podzol with placic pan": "Podzol with a thin (about 2–10 mm), wavy, hard, dark iron pan.",
  "Prismacutanic": "Abrupt change to a clay-enriched subsoil with vertical prisms and cutans; not gleyed.",
  "Pedocutanic": "Moderately to strongly blocky subsoil with cutans, usually clay-enriched; not gleyed.",
  "Neocutanic": "Young, weakly structured subsoil with colour variegation; not gleyed and not calcareous.",
  "Neocarbonate": "Like neocutanic but calcareous (fizzes with cold 10% HCl), with soil material still dominant.",
  "Soft Carbonate": "Carbonate dominates (powdery, nodular or honeycomb lime); not cemented; not gleyed.",
  "Hard Carbonate": "Continuous, cemented calcrete layer; very hard; little soil.",
  "Gypsic": "At least 5% gypsum, powdery or crystalline, sometimes cemented; arid areas.",
  "Dorbank": "Reddish-brown hardpan cemented by silica; arid areas.",
  "Alluvial": "Unconsolidated, usually finely layered river deposit with little horizon development.",
  "Unconsolidated Material with Wetness": "Unconsolidated, poorly sorted colluvial or deposited material with grey (gleyed) colours in part.",
  "Regic Sand": "Recent wind-blown sand with no soil development.",
  "Lithic": "Weathering rock with soil between the fragments, or saprolite that still shows rock structure.",
  "Hard Rock": "Hard rock with no soil between the fractures."
};
/* Family criterion help, our wording, from the book's Section A6. */
const FAMHELP = [
  [/topsoil colour/i, t => /vertic/i.test(t) ? "Dark: moist value ≤ 4 and chroma ≤ 2. Red: hue 5YR or redder." : "Dark: moist value ≤ 4 and chroma ≤ 2. Chromic: value ≤ 4 and chroma ≥ 3. Bleached (grey): value ≥ 5 and chroma ≤ 3."],
  [/base status/i, () => "Sum of exchangeable Ca, Mg, K and Na per kg clay (S-value × 100 ÷ clay %): dystrophic < 5, mesotrophic 5–15, eutrophic > 15 cmol(+)/kg clay."],
  [/textural contrast/i, () => "Luvic: if the topsoil or albic layer has ≤ 15% clay, the horizon below has at least 5 percentage points more; if > 15% clay, more than 1.3 times as much. Otherwise aluvic."],
  [/thickness of humic/i, () => "Thin: less than 450 mm. Thick: 450 mm or more."],
  [/lithic weathering/i, () => "Saprolithic: soft, highly weathered rock that still shows rock structure. Geolithic: soil infilling or tongues between rock fragments, not gleyed. Gleylithic: the same, but gleyed."],
  [/rock weathering/i, () => "Fractured: many fracture planes. Solid: few, widely spaced fractures."],
  [/decomposition/i, () => "Fibric: mostly recognisable plant remains (von Post H1–H3). Hemic: intermediate (H4–H6). Sapric: mostly decomposed (H7–H10)."],
  [/lime/i, () => "Calcareous: some part fizzes visibly with cold 10% HCl."],
  [/sepiolite/i, () => "Sepiolite: ≥ 10%, white to yellow, does not fizz with acid; confirm in the lab (XRD or electron microscopy)."],
  [/albic colour/i, () => "Albic horizons are grey when dry. Grey: also grey when moist (longer wetness). Yellow: yellow-brown when moist."],
  [/vertic properties/i, () => "Vertic properties: plasticity index ≥ 30 (lab confirmed); strong structure, many cutans and coarse cracks help in the field. Brown and red follow the yellow-brown and red apedal colour definitions."],
  [/ortstein/i, () => "Ortstein: in or below the podzol, at least 50% cemented and more than 25 mm thick."],
  [/consistence of underlying/i, () => "Firm: needs at least moderate thumb–finger pressure to crush. Friable: crushes under gentle pressure."],
  [/consistence and\/or texture of gley/i, () => "Friable and/or sand to loamy sand, or slightly firm and/or sandy loam or finer."],
  [/alluvial wetness/i, () => "Wet: grey (albic-type) colours in at least 10% of the matrix, or free water present."],
  [/gleying/i, () => "Gleyed: grey (albic-type) matrix colours in or below the horizon."],
  [/lamellae/i, () => "Thin, wavy layers enriched in clay, oxides or organic matter, usually first appearing at 40–100 cm."],
  [/colour of/i, () => "Colours are judged in the dry state. Brown follows the yellow-brown apedal definition, red the red apedal definition, grey the albic definition."],
  [/black cutans/i, () => "Continuous black cutans on vertical ped faces, usually a sign of a wetter soil climate."]
];
const famHelp = name => { for (const [re, f] of FAMHELP) if (re.test(name)) return f(name); return ""; };
const nice = s => s === "THICK" ? "continues to 1.5 m" : s.replace("+", ", then ");
let S = {};
const reset = () => { S = { stage: "intro", depth: "", top: null, s1: null, path: [], form: null, fam: {}, note: null, cond: null }; };
reset();
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const view = () => document.getElementById("sa-view");
function setStage(st) { S.stage = st; render(); window.scrollTo(0, Math.max(0, document.querySelector(".sakey").offsetTop - 70)); }
function card(inner) { return `<div class="wk-card">${inner}</div>`; }
function optBtns(opts) {
  return `<div class="answers">${opts.map((o, i) => `<button data-i="${i}" class="${o.cls || ""}">${o.label}${o.sub ? `<span style="display:block; font-weight:400; font-size:.85rem; color:inherit; opacity:.8">${o.sub}</span>` : ""}</button>`).join("")}</div>`;
}
function bind(opts) { view().querySelectorAll("[data-i]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => opts[+b.dataset.i].go()); }
function back() { const p = S.path.pop(); if (p) { Object.assign(S, p); render(); } }
function push() { S.path.push({ stage: S.stage, top: S.top, s1: S.s1, form: S.form, note: S.note, cond: S.cond, fam: { ...S.fam } }); }
function navBack() { return `<div class="wk-nav"><button id="sback">← Back</button><span></span></div>`; }
function bindBack() { const b = $("sback"); if (b) b.onclick = back; }

function render() {
  $("sa-restart").hidden = S.stage === "intro";
  const st = S.stage;
  if (st === "intro") return intro();
  if (st === "top") return topQ();
  if (st === "s1") return s1Q();
  if (st === "thick") return thickQ();
  if (st === "s2") return s2Q();
  if (st === "family") return familyQ();
  if (st === "browse") return browse();
  if (st === "topsoilonly" || st === "notinkey") return special();
}
function intro() {
  view().innerHTML = card(`<h1>Classify a South African soil</h1>
    <p>Work down the profile, choosing each diagnostic horizon from the surface. The app finds the soil form, then asks the family questions to build the full name and code, for example <b>Avalon 2210 (1.1 m)</b>.</p>
    <div class="fld" style="margin-top:12px"><label>Observation depth (cm, optional)</label><input type="number" inputmode="decimal" id="sdepth" placeholder="e.g. 150" value="${S.depth}"></div>
    <div class="modes">
      <button id="sgo"><b>Identify the soil form</b><span>Topsoil, then subsoil horizons, then family.</span></button>
      <button id="sbrowse"><b>Browse all 135 forms</b><span>Already know the form? Go straight to its family table.</span></button>
    </div>
    <ul class="intro" style="margin-top:14px"><li>This covers natural soils (Section A). For soils strongly altered by people (Anthrosols, Technosols), use Section B of the book.</li><li>Horizon descriptions here are short summaries. Always check the full definitions in the book.</li></ul>`);
  $("sdepth").oninput = e => { S.depth = e.target.value; };
  $("sgo").onclick = () => { push(); setStage("top"); };
  $("sbrowse").onclick = () => { push(); setStage("browse"); };
}
function topQ() {
  const opts = TOPS.map(t => ({ label: t, sub: HZ[t], go: () => { push(); S.top = t; setStage("s1"); } }));
  view().innerHTML = `<div class="step">Step 1 · Topsoil</div>` + card(`<h1>Which diagnostic topsoil is it?</h1>${optBtns(opts)}`) + navBack();
  bind(opts); bindBack();
}
function rowsTS(t, s1) { return FORMS.filter(f => f.t === t && (s1 == null || f.s1 === s1)); }
function s1Q() {
  const s1s = [...new Set(rowsTS(S.top).map(f => f.s1))];
  const opts = s1s.map(s => ({ label: s, sub: HZ[s] || "", go: () => { push(); S.s1 = s; afterS1(); } }));
  opts.push({ label: "Observation stopped in the topsoil", cls: "unsure", go: () => { push(); S.note = "topsoil"; setStage("topsoilonly"); } });
  opts.push({ label: "Another horizon not listed here", cls: "unsure", go: () => { push(); S.note = `${S.top} over a subsoil that is not in the key for this topsoil`; setStage("notinkey"); } });
  view().innerHTML = `<div class="step">Step 2 · First subsoil horizon under ${S.top.toLowerCase()} topsoil</div>` + card(`<h1>Which diagnostic horizon comes next?</h1><p>Only horizons that form a recognised sequence with a ${S.top.toLowerCase()} topsoil are listed.</p>${optBtns(opts)}`) + navBack();
  bind(opts); bindBack();
}
function afterS1() {
  const rs = rowsTS(S.top, S.s1);
  if (rs.length === 1 && rs[0].s2 === "-") return chooseForm(rs[0]);
  if (rs.some(r => r.s2 === "THICK")) return setStage("thick");
  setStage("s2");
}
function thickQ() {
  const rs = rowsTS(S.top, S.s1), th = rs.find(r => r.s2 === "THICK");
  const opts = [
    { label: "Yes, one uniform horizon to 1.5 m or deeper", cls: "yes", go: () => { push(); chooseForm(th); } },
    { label: "No, another horizon starts above 1.5 m", go: () => { push(); rs.some(r => r.s2 !== "THICK") ? setStage("s2") : (S.note = `${S.top} / ${S.s1} over another horizon`, setStage("notinkey")); } },
    { label: "Observation stopped above 1.5 m", cls: "unsure", go: () => { push(); S.cond = true; chooseForm(th); } }
  ];
  view().innerHTML = `<div class="step">Step 3 · Thickness</div>` + card(`<h1>Does the ${S.s1.toLowerCase()} horizon continue to at least 1.5 m?</h1><p>If it does, the soil form is defined by this single thick horizon.</p>${optBtns(opts)}`) + navBack();
  bind(opts); bindBack();
}
function s2Q() {
  const rs = rowsTS(S.top, S.s1), list = rs.filter(r => r.s2 !== "-" && r.s2 !== "THICK"), dash = rs.find(r => r.s2 === "-"), th = rs.find(r => r.s2 === "THICK");
  const opts = list.map(r => ({ label: nice(r.s2), sub: r.s2.split("+").map(x => HZ[x]).filter(Boolean)[0] || "", go: () => { push(); chooseForm(r); } }));
  opts.push({ label: dash ? "None of these, or no further horizon recognised" : "Another horizon not listed here", cls: "unsure", go: () => { push(); if (dash) chooseForm(dash); else { S.note = `${S.top} / ${S.s1} over a horizon that is not in the key`; setStage("notinkey"); } } });
  opts.push({ label: "Observation stopped before the next horizon", cls: "unsure", go: () => { push(); S.cond = true; const pick = th || dash; if (pick) chooseForm(pick); else { S.note = `${S.top} / ${S.s1}, observation too shallow to identify the next horizon`; setStage("notinkey"); } } });
  view().innerHTML = `<div class="step">Step 3 · Second subsoil horizon under ${S.s1.toLowerCase()}</div>` + card(`<h1>What lies below the ${S.s1.toLowerCase()} horizon?</h1>${optBtns(opts)}`) + navBack();
  bind(opts); bindBack();
}
function chooseForm(f) { S.form = f; S.fam = {}; setStage("family"); }
const depthTxt = () => S.depth ? ` (${(S.depth / 100).toFixed(S.depth % 100 ? 2 : 1).replace(/0$/, "")} m)` : "";
function famCode(f) { const d = ["0", "0", "0", "0"]; f.fam.forEach((c, i) => { d[c.pos] = S.fam[i] ? String(S.fam[i]) : "?"; }); return d.join(""); }
function seqTxt(f) { return [f.t, f.s1].concat(f.s2 === "-" ? [] : f.s2 === "THICK" ? ["(thick)"] : f.s2.split("+")).join(" / "); }
function familyQ() {
  const f = S.form, code = famCode(f), done = f.fam.every((c, i) => S.fam[i]);
  const cond = S.cond ? `<div class="flag"><strong>Conditional.</strong> Observation stopped before the full sequence could be confirmed, so the name is conditional and the depth must be stated. The form may change with deeper observation; other forms starting ${f.t.toLowerCase()} / ${f.s1.toLowerCase()} are ${rowsTS(f.t, f.s1).filter(r => r !== f).map(r => r.name).join(", ") || "none"}.</div>` : "";
  const name = `${S.cond ? "“" : ""}${f.name}${S.cond ? "”" : ""} ${code}${depthTxt()}`, short = `${f.code}${code}${depthTxt()}`;
  view().innerHTML = `<div class="step">Soil form</div>` + card(`<span class="code">${f.code}</span>
    <div class="rsg" style="font-size:1.9rem; font-weight:700; margin:2px 0 4px">${f.name}</div>
    <p>${seqTxt(f)} · family table on p. ${f.page} of the book</p>${cond}
    <div class="qname" style="margin-top:12px">${name}<br><span style="font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-2)">${short}</span></div>
    ${done ? "" : `<p class="hint" style="font-size:.85rem; color:var(--ink-3)">Answer the family questions below to complete the code (? = not yet answered).</p>`}
    <div class="row2" style="margin-top:6px"><button class="secondary" id="scopy" style="margin:0">Copy name</button></div>
    <h2 style="margin-top:18px">Family</h2>
    ${f.fam.map((c, i) => `<div class="fam" style="margin-top:14px"><div style="font-weight:600">${c.name}</div>
      ${famHelp(c.name) ? `<div style="font-size:.85rem; color:var(--ink-3); margin:2px 0 6px">${famHelp(c.name)}</div>` : ""}
      <div class="answers" style="margin-top:6px">${c.options.map((o, k) => `<button data-c="${i}" data-k="${k + 1}" class="${S.fam[i] === k + 1 ? "yes" : ""}" style="min-height:44px; text-align:left; padding:8px 12px"><b>${k + 1}</b> · ${o}</button>`).join("")}</div></div>`).join("")}
    <button class="primary" id="snew">Classify another profile</button>`) + navBack();
  view().querySelectorAll("[data-c]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { S.fam[+b.dataset.c] = +b.dataset.k; const y = window.scrollY; familyQ(); window.scrollTo(0, y); });
  $("scopy").onclick = async () => { try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${name} / ${short}`); $("scopy").textContent = "Copied"; } catch (e) { $("scopy").textContent = name; } };
  $("snew").onclick = () => { const d = S.depth; reset(); S.depth = d; setStage("top"); };
  bindBack();
}
function special() {
  const t = S.stage === "topsoilonly";
  view().innerHTML = `<div class="step">${t ? "Topsoil only" : "Not in the key"}</div>` + card(t
    ? `<h1>“${S.top} soil”${depthTxt()}</h1><p>When only the topsoil can be observed, the soil takes the name of its topsoil, with the observation depth stated.</p>`
    : `<h1>Sequence not in the key</h1><p>${S.note}.</p><p>The book allows a provisional new soil form when a topsoil and two subsoil horizons are clearly identified but the sequence isn't in the key, provided a full data set (profile description, lab data, distribution and a photograph) is sent to the Soil Classification Working Group.</p><p>Before that, re-check the horizon calls against the full definitions, as a misidentified horizon is the more common cause.</p>`) + `<button class="primary" id="snew">Start again</button>` + navBack();
  $("snew").onclick = () => { const d = S.depth; reset(); S.depth = d; setStage("top"); };
  bindBack();
}
function browse() {
  let h = `<div class="step">All soil forms</div>` + card(`<h1>Browse soil forms</h1><div class="fld"><input id="sq" placeholder="Search by name, code or horizon" autocomplete="off"></div><div id="slist" style="margin-top:10px"></div>`) + navBack();
  view().innerHTML = h;
  const draw = q => {
    q = (q || "").toLowerCase();
    let out = "";
    TOPS.forEach(t => {
      const rs = FORMS.filter(f => f.t === t && (!q || (f.name + " " + f.code + " " + seqTxt(f)).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
      if (!rs.length) return;
      out += `<div class="sec">${t} topsoil</div>` + rs.map(f => `<div class="chk" style="grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr; cursor:pointer" data-f="${f.code}"><span class="s y">${f.code}</span><span class="t"><b>${f.name}</b> · ${seqTxt(f)}</span></div>`).join("");
    });
    $("slist").innerHTML = out || "<p>No forms match.</p>";
    $("slist").querySelectorAll("[data-f]").forEach(e => e.onclick = () => { push(); S.cond = false; chooseForm(FORMS.find(f => f.code === e.dataset.f)); });
  };
  $("sq").oninput = e => draw(e.target.value); draw("");
  bindBack();
}
$("sa-restart").onclick = () => { reset(); render(); };
render();
})();
</script>
</div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const btns = document.querySelectorAll(".keyswitch [data-key]");
  function show(k, push) {
    btns.forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(b.dataset.key === k)));
    document.querySelectorAll(".keypane").forEach(p => p.hidden = p.dataset.pane !== k);
    if (push) history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + k);
  }
  btns.forEach(b => b.onclick = () => show(b.dataset.key, true));
  show(location.hash === "#sa" ? "sa" : "wrb", false);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => { if (location.hash === "#sa" || location.hash === "#wrb") show(location.hash.slice(1), false); });
})();
</script>
